onset.Description: Onset of a block of images

duration.Description: Total duration of visual stimulus or imagery epoch of a trial

trial_type.Description: Describes whether the block of trials involves negative or neutral images

Image1.Description: This is the first image presented in the block. The image duration is 2.5s. There is no inter stimulus interval.

Image3.Description: This is the third image presented in the block. The image duration is 2.5s. There is no inter stimulus interval.

Image4.Description: This is the Fourth image presented in the block. The image duration is 2.5s. There is no inter stimulus interval.

ImageOn1.Description: This is the onset time for the first image presented in the block. The image duration is 2.5s. There is no inter stimulus interval.

ImageOn3.Description: This is the onset time for the third image presented in the block. The image duration is 2.5s. There is no inter stimulus interval.

ImageOn4.Description: This is the onset time for the Fourth image presented in the block. The image duration is 2.5s. There is no inter stimulus interval.
